R7BE-grouse-atv-0003.name: 3.6 km N of Blanchard Creek
R7BE-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BE-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 282 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.26781, -125.00029, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 2.4 km to the start. Ride: the Akie M/L stretch, 4.6 km one way. About 92 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-41, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BE-grouse-atv-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-41: about 407 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
